flavor.en: Thought to be one of the first Pokémon to live in harmony with humans, it has a placid disposition.

flavor.es: Percibe los sentimientos del Entrenador por la forma en la que agarra sus cuernos, aunque sean variaciones sutiles, y así avanzan como si fueran un solo ente.
flavor.en: It can tell how its Trainer is feeling by subtle shifts in the grip on its horns. This empathic sense lets them run as if one being.

flavor.es: Se esfuerza mucho para que el enemigo no lo menosprecie, pero su mirada no intimida demasiado. Se caracteriza por mascar siempre una hoja.
flavor.en: It does its best to be taken seriously by its enemies, but its glare is not sufficiently intimidating. Chewing on a leaf is its trademark.

flavor.es: Es muy temperamental, pero no permite que nadie se meta con los débiles. Mediante su hoja, predice los movimientos del enemigo.
flavor.en: Although it possesses a violent temperament, it won’t put up with bullying. It uses the leaf in its mouth to sense the movements of its enemies.

flavor.es: Cuando le esquilan su mullido pelaje, no solo mejora su apariencia, sino que aumenta su agilidad.
flavor.en: Trimming its fluffy fur not only makes it more elegant but also increases the swiftness of its movements.

flavor.es: Protege con las orejas el órgano con el que irradia su intenso poder psíquico para evitar que este se escape al exterior.
flavor.en: The organ that emits its intense psychic power is sheltered by its ears to keep power from leaking out.

flavor.es: Cuando percibe peligro, yergue sus orejas y desata un poder psíquico capaz de levantar un camión de unas 10 toneladas.
flavor.en: When in danger, it raises its ears and releases enough psychic power to grind a 10-ton truck into dust.

flavor.es: Cuentan que este Pokémon nace cuando el espíritu de un difunto toma posesión de una espada antigua. Se aferra a las personas y absorbe su energía.
flavor.en: Apparently this Pokémon is born when a departed spirit inhabits a sword. It attaches itself to people and drinks their life force.

flavor.es: Al evolucionar se divide en dos espadas. Se comunican entre sí mediante telepatía y coordinan los ataques para rebanar al enemigo.
flavor.en: When Honedge evolves, it divides into two swords, which cooperate via telepathy to coordinate attacks and slash their enemies to ribbons.

flavor.es: Han permanecido junto a estirpes de reyes durante generaciones. Mediante su poder espectral pueden controlar a humanos y a Pokémon.
flavor.en: Generations of kings were attended by these Pokémon, which used their spectral power to manipulate and control people and Pokémon.

flavor.es: Su cuerpo emana una fragancia que embelesa a quien la huele. La fragancia es diferente según los alimentos que ingiere.
flavor.en: It emits a scent that enraptures those who smell it. This fragrance changes depending on what it has eaten.

flavor.es: Puede producir multitud de olores diferentes y, en combate, secreta los que le resultan molestos al enemigo para así contar con cierta ventaja.
flavor.en: It devises various scents, pleasant and unpleasant, and emits scents that its enemies dislike in order to gain an edge in battle.

flavor.es: Escupe hebras pegajosas de color blanco y textura parecida a la del algodón de azúcar, con las que envuelve al enemigo y le impide que se mueva.
flavor.en: To entangle its opponents in battle, it extrudes white threads as sweet and sticky as cotton candy.

flavor.es: Puede rastrear hasta el más débil de los olores. Hace uso de su fino olfato para ayudar a los pasteleros más exquisitos.
flavor.en: It can distinguish the faintest of scents. It puts its sensitive sense of smell to use by helping pastry chefs in their work.

flavor.es: Los enemigos que contemplan el titilante fulgor de su brillante cuerpo terminan mareándose y pierden las ganas de continuar combatiendo.
flavor.en: Opponents who stare at the flashing of the light-emitting spots on its body become dazed and lose their will to fight.

flavor.es: Tiene a su disposición los poderes hipnóticos más poderosos de entre todos los Pokémon. Controla al enemigo a su voluntad.
flavor.en: It wields the most compelling hypnotic powers of any Pokémon, and it forces others to do whatever it wants.

flavor.es: Dos Binacle conviven en la misma roca, pero cuando se produce un altercado entre ambos, uno de ellos se muda a otra.
flavor.en: Two Binacle live together on one rock. When they fight, one of them will move to a different rock.

flavor.es: Al evolucionar, los dos Binacle se dividen y dan lugar a siete criaturas que se aglomeran formando un Barbaracle y suman su poder al combatir.
flavor.en: When they evolve, two Binacle multiply into seven. They fight with the power of seven Binacle.

flavor.es: Adopta la apariencia de algas podridas y lanza un líquido venenoso a las presas desprevenidas que pasan cerca.
flavor.en: Camouflaged as rotten kelp, they spray liquid poison on prey that approaches unawares and then finish it off.

flavor.es: Ataca de manera indiscriminada a quien ose adentrarse en su territorio, escupiéndole un virulento veneno que puede corroer hasta el casco de un petrolero.
flavor.en: Their poison is strong enough to eat through the hull of a tanker, and they spit it indiscriminately at anything that enters their territory.

flavor.es: Abate a enemigos voladores disparando agua a presión con su enorme pinza como si de una pistola se tratara.
flavor.en: They knock down flying prey by firing compressed water from their massive claws like shooting a pistol.

flavor.es: Posee una enorme pinza que dispara bolas de agua que podrían atravesar incluso el casco de un petrolero.
flavor.en: Their enormous claws launch cannonballs of water powerful enough to pierce tanker hulls.

flavor.es: Habita en los desiertos y, cuando toma el sol, acumula energía, lo que le permite vivir sin la necesidad de ingerir alimentos.
flavor.en: They make their home in deserts. They can generate their energy from basking in the sun, so eating food is not a requirement.

flavor.es: Extiende su gorguera y genera energía eléctrica suficiente para cubrir el consumo de electricidad de un rascacielos entero.
flavor.en: They flare their frills and generate energy. A single Heliolisk can generate sufficient electricity to power a skyscraper.

flavor.es: Pokémon recreado a partir de fósiles. Cuando sucede algo que no es de su agrado, se enfurece y se vuelve violento.
flavor.en: This Pokémon was restored from a fossil. If something happens that it doesn’t like, it throws a tantrum and runs wild.

flavor.es: En el mundo antiguo en el que habitaba no tenía rivales gracias a sus mandíbulas, con las que podría despedazar con facilidad gruesas placas de acero.
flavor.en: Thanks to its gargantuan jaws, which could shred thick metal plates as if they were paper, it was invincible in the ancient world it once inhabited.

flavor.es: Pokémon que ha sido regenerado a partir de un trozo de su antiguo cuerpo, que quedó congelado hace unos 100 millones de años.
flavor.en: This ancient Pokémon was restored from part of its body that had been frozen in ice for over 100 million years.

flavor.es: Expulsa un gas gélido a temperaturas inferiores a los -150 ºC a través de sus cristales romboides y congela así a su enemigo.
flavor.en: The diamond-shaped crystals on its body expel air as cold as -240 degrees Fahrenheit, surrounding its enemies and encasing them in ice.

flavor.es: A través de sus apéndices sensitivos con forma de cinta, emite unas ondas tranquilizadoras mediante las cuales detiene los combates.
flavor.en: It sends a soothing aura from its ribbonlike feelers to calm fights.

flavor.es: A pesar de ser un Pokémon de pequeña estatura, su pericia en el combate le permite plantar cara a Pokémon como Machamp o Hariyama.
flavor.en: Although its body is small, its proficient fighting skills enable it to keep up with big bruisers like Machamp and Hariyama.

flavor.es: Sus bigotes hacen la función de antenas, por lo que puede enviar y recibir ondas eléctricas para comunicarse a grandes distancias.
flavor.en: Its whiskers serve as antennas. By sending and receiving electrical waves, it can communicate with others over vast distances.

flavor.es: Nace en las profundidades subterráneas, a altas temperaturas y a gran presión. Irradia energía por la roca que tiene en la cabeza.
flavor.en: Born from the temperatures and pressures deep underground, it fires beams from the stone in its head.

flavor.es: Es el Pokémon de tipo Dragón más débil. Habita en zonas oscuras y húmedas para evitar que su viscoso cuerpo se seque.
flavor.en: The weakest Dragon-type Pokémon, it lives in damp, shady places, so its body doesn’t dry out.

flavor.es: Segrega una mucosidad que corroe todo lo que toca y consigue así ahuyentar al enemigo. Sus ojos han involucionado, por lo que no puede ver.
flavor.en: It drives away opponents by excreting a sticky liquid that can dissolve anything. Its eyes devolved, so it can’t see anything.

flavor.es: Pokémon de tipo Dragón muy afable al que le gusta abrazar con efusión a su Entrenador, aunque después lo deja totalmente pringado.
flavor.en: This very friendly Dragon-type Pokémon will hug its beloved Trainer, leaving that Trainer covered in sticky slime.

flavor.es: Tiene el hábito de coleccionar llaves. Cuando un enemigo lo ataca, las hace tintinear como método de intimidación.
flavor.en: These key collectors threaten any attackers by fiercely jingling their keys at them.

flavor.es: Pokémon que nace cuando un espíritu se adentra en un tocón podrido. Habita en bosques que son poco frecuentados por humanos.
flavor.en: These Pokémon are created when spirits possess rotten tree stumps. They prefer to live in abandoned forests.

flavor.es: Puede controlar los árboles a su voluntad. Retiene hasta el fin de sus días a los humanos que se adentran en el bosque y lo mancillan.
flavor.en: It can control trees at will. It will trap people who harm the forest, so they can never leave.

flavor.es: En el interior de la calabaza reside un espíritu que ha permanecido atrapado en este mundo. Entra en acción al caer la noche.
flavor.en: The pumpkin body is inhabited by a spirit trapped in this world. As the sun sets, it becomes restless and active.

flavor.es: En las noches de luna nueva deambula por las calles de las ciudades y emite espeluznantes alaridos que maldicen a quienes los oyen.
flavor.en: Singing in eerie voices, they wander town streets on the night of the new moon. Anyone who hears their song is cursed.

flavor.es: Envuelve su cuerpo en una capa de hielo que le permite evitar los ataques del enemigo. Si se resquebraja, la recompone con aire gélido.
flavor.en: It blocks opponents’ attacks with the ice that shields its body. It uses cold air to repair any cracks with new ice.

flavor.es: Su cuerpo, cubierto de hielo, es tan duro como el propio acero. Su abultada figura le permite arramblar con todo lo que se encuentra a su paso.
flavor.en: Its ice-covered body is as hard as steel. Its cumbersome frame crushes anything that stands in its way.

flavor.es: Habita en cuevas donde reina la más absoluta oscuridad y emite ondas ultrasónicas de 200 000 Hz a través de sus enormes orejas.
flavor.en: They live in pitch-black caves. Their enormous ears can emit ultrasonic waves of 200,000 hertz.

flavor.es: Surca el cielo nocturno cuando ni siquiera la luna brilla y ataca a presas incautas. Es imbatible en combates que tienen lugar a oscuras.
flavor.en: They fly around on moonless nights and attack careless prey. Nothing can beat them in a battle in the dark.

flavor.es: Según las leyendas, puede compartir el secreto de la vida eterna. Ha despertado tras dormir durante mil años bajo la apariencia de un árbol.
flavor.en: Legends say it can share eternal life. It slept for a thousand years in the form of a tree before its revival.

flavor.es: Pokémon legendario que, al extender sus alas y las plumas de la cola, emite un brillo carmesí que absorbe la energía vital de su enemigo.
flavor.en: When this legendary Pokémon’s wings and tail feathers spread wide and glow red, it absorbs the life force of living creatures.

flavor.es: Cuando el ecosistema de Kalos se encuentra en peligro, aparece y revela su poder secreto.
flavor.en: When the Kalos region’s ecosystem falls into disarray, it appears and reveals its secret power.

flavor.es: Es una transformación súbita de Carbink. Se dice que su cuerpo, que irradia destellos rosados, es lo más bonito de este mundo.
flavor.en: A sudden transformation of Carbink, its pink, glimmering body is said to be the loveliest sight in the whole world.

flavor.es: Este problemático Pokémon envía cualquier objeto a lugares remotos mediante unos anillos que deforman el espacio.
flavor.en: This troublemaker sends anything and everything to faraway places using its loop, which can warp space.

flavor.es: Expulsa vapor y desaparece entre la densa niebla. Dicen que habita en montañas solitarias.
flavor.en: It lets out billows of steam and disappears into the dense fog. It’s said to live in mountains where humans do not tread.

flavor.es: Es cauteloso, desconfiado y de naturaleza nocturna. Durante el día acumula energía mediante la fotosíntesis.
flavor.en: This wary Pokémon uses photosynthesis to store up energy during the day, while becoming active at night.

flavor.es: Es un poco coqueto, por lo que, cuando puede, se acicala las alas. En ocasiones se niega a combatir por temor a mancharse las plumas.
flavor.en: A bit of a dandy, it spends its free time preening its wings. Its preoccupation with any dirt on its plumage can leave it unable to battle.

flavor.es: Las plumas de sus alas le sirven de flechas con las que puede acertar a un guijarro a 100 m.
flavor.en: It fires arrow quills from its wings with such precision, they can pierce a pebble at distances over a hundred yards.

flavor.es: Prende las bolas de pelo que se forman en su estómago tras acicalarse. Las llamas que escupe tienen formas variopintas.
flavor.en: While grooming itself, it builds up fur inside its stomach. It sets the fur alight and spews fiery attacks, which change based on how it coughs.

flavor.es: Luce al cuello un cascabel incandescente que tintinea con fuerza cuando desprende llamas.
flavor.en: At its throat, it bears a bell of fire. The bell rings brightly whenever this Pokémon spits fire.

flavor.es: Posee un carácter rudo y egoísta. Si un Entrenador no le cae en gracia, ignora sus órdenes con total impasibilidad.
flavor.en: This Pokémon has a violent, selfish disposition. If it’s not in the mood to listen, it will ignore its Trainer’s orders with complete nonchalance.

flavor.es: Se le conoce por su diligencia y predisposición. Segrega agua por la nariz para hinchar globos con los que golpea a sus rivales.
flavor.en: This Pokémon snorts body fluids from its nose, blowing balloons to smash into its foes. It’s famous for being a hard worker.

flavor.es: Un bailarín consumado. Crea globos de agua con los que golpea a sus rivales una y otra vez sin dejar de bailar.
flavor.en: A skillful dancer, it creates a sequence of water balloons as it dances, and briskly bombards its enemies.

flavor.es: Es capaz de controlar globos de agua mediante un canto cuya melodía se ha transmitido entre los suyos de generación en generación.
flavor.en: It controls its water balloons with song. The melody is learned from others of its kind and is passed down from one generation to the next.

flavor.es: Hace agujeros en los árboles a una velocidad de 16 picotazos por segundo y los utiliza como despensa o como su nido.
flavor.en: It can peck at a rate of 16 times a second to drill holes in trees. It uses the holes for food storage and for nesting.

flavor.es: Almacena en su pico las semillas de las bayas de las que se alimenta para usarlas como arma contra enemigos y posibles presas.
flavor.en: It eats berries and stores their seeds in its beak. When it encounters enemies or prey, it fires off all the seeds in a burst.

flavor.es: Cuando va a combatir, calienta su pico hasta temperaturas que superan los 100 °C, lo que puede causar graves quemaduras al contacto.
flavor.en: When it battles, its beak heats up. The temperature can easily exceed 212 degrees Fahrenheit, causing severe burns when it hits.

flavor.es: Sus afilados colmillos lo atraviesan todo. No es autóctono de Alola, sino que proviene de otra región.
flavor.en: With its sharp fangs, it will bite anything. It did not originally live in Alola but was imported from another region.

flavor.es: Al detectar el rastro de una presa, la acecha con tenacidad, pero al ponerse el sol le vence el sueño.
flavor.en: When it finds a trace of its prey, it patiently stakes out the location...but it’s always snoozing by nightfall.

flavor.es: Con sus duras mandíbulas arranca la corteza de los árboles y sorbe la savia. Suele habitar bajo tierra.
flavor.en: Its strong jaw enables it to scrape trees and slurp out the sap. It normally lives underground.

flavor.es: Almacena electricidad en su cuerpo, lo que puede resultar útil en numerosas situaciones, como al salir de acampada.
flavor.en: Its body is capable of storing electricity. On camping trips, people are grateful to have one around.

flavor.es: Sobrevuela un área en busca de presas. Puede concentrar una potente carga eléctrica entre sus mandíbulas para atacar a sus rivales.
flavor.en: It zips around, on sharp lookout for an opening. It concentrates electrical energy within its large jaws and uses it to zap its enemies.

flavor.es: Protege sus puntos débiles con las pinzas y propina puñetazos en cuanto tiene ocasión. Cuando pierde, llora lágrimas espumosas.
flavor.en: While guarding its weak points with its pincers, it looks for an opening and unleashes punches. When it loses, it foams at the mouth and faints.

flavor.es: Tras perderse intentando coronar una alta montaña, desarrolló una capa de pelo para protegerse del frío.
flavor.en: It aimed for the top but got lost and ended up on a snowy mountain. Being forced to endure the cold, this Pokémon evolved and grew fur.

flavor.es: Junta las alas y lanza voraces llamas al rival. Su ataque se asemeja a una elaborada coreografía de fuego.
flavor.en: It beats its wings together to create fire. As it moves in the steps of its beautiful dance, it bathes opponents in intense flames.

flavor.es: Se alimenta de néctar y polen. Es capaz de detectar los capullos que están a punto de abrirse.
flavor.en: It feeds on the nectar and pollen of flowers. Because it’s able to sense auras, it can identify which flowers are about to bloom.

flavor.es: Fabrica varios tipos de bolas de polen. Algunas se usan como alimento y otras para el combate.
flavor.en: It rolls up pollen into puffs. It makes many different varieties, some used as food and others used in battle.

flavor.es: Su carácter amigable lo convierte en el Pokémon ideal para Entrenadores novatos. Sin embargo, al crecer suele volverse un poco agresivo.
flavor.en: It’s considered to be a good Pokémon for beginners because of its friendliness, but its disposition grows rougher as it grows up.

flavor.es: Su velocidad desconcierta a sus rivales. Ataca con garras, colmillos y con las piedras afiladas de su melena.
flavor.en: Its quick movements confuse its enemies. Well equipped with claws and fangs, it also uses the sharp rocks in its mane as weapons.

flavor.es: Al sentirse amenazado, sus ojos emiten cierto brillo, algo que atrae a otros miembros de su especie, y juntos luchan como un mismo ente.
flavor.en: When it’s in trouble, its eyes moisten and begin to shine. The shining light attracts its comrades, and they stand together against their enemies.

flavor.es: Aturde a su presa con los aguijones venenosos de la cabeza. Cuando esta se debilita, la rodea con sus diez extremidades y la remata.
flavor.en: It plunges the poison spike on its head into its prey. When the prey has weakened, Mareanie deals the finishing blow with its 10 tentacles.

flavor.es: Se arrastra por el lecho marino con sus doce extremidades. Deja siempre una estela de restos de Corsola por donde pasa.
flavor.en: Toxapex crawls along the ocean floor on its 12 legs. It leaves a trail of Corsola bits scattered in its wake.

flavor.es: El lodo que impregna sus patas le otorga una fuerte tracción, lo que le permite alcanzar altas velocidades al correr.
flavor.en: The mud stuck to Mudbray’s hooves enhances its grip and its powerful running gait.

flavor.es: El lodo que segrega por la boca se vuelve impermeable al secarse, por lo que solía usarse como capa aislante en las paredes de las casas.
flavor.en: It spits a mud that provides resistance to both wind and rain, so the walls of old houses were often coated with it.

flavor.es: Emerge a la superficie para alimentarse. La burbuja con la que se rodea le sirve para respirar y proteger su delicada cabeza.
flavor.en: It crawls onto the land in search of food. Its water bubble allows it to breathe and protects its soft head.

flavor.es: Propina cabezazos con su burbuja. Los Pokémon de menor tamaño quedan atrapados en su interior y perecen ahogados.
flavor.en: It delivers headbutts with the water bubble on its head. Small Pokémon get sucked into the bubble, where they drown.

flavor.es: Mientras que de día duerme tranquilamente a la luz del sol, al caer la noche busca un sitio más seguro para dormir.
flavor.en: During the day, it sleeps and soaks up light. When night falls, it walks around looking for a safer place to sleep.

flavor.es: Dedica mucho tiempo y esfuerzo a acicalarse y preservar sus vivos colores. A algunos ejemplares incluso les lleva todo el día.
flavor.en: It requires a lot of effort to maintain Lurantis’s vivid coloring, but some collectors enjoy this work and treat it as their hobby.

flavor.es: Cuando titila, esparce esporas luminosas a su alrededor. Todo aquel que ve esta luz cae en un profundo sueño.
flavor.en: It scatters spores that flicker and glow. Anyone seeing these lights falls into a deep slumber.

flavor.es: Es peligroso adentrarse por la noche en un bosque habitado por Shiinotic. Su luz confunde a los caminantes, que terminan perdiéndose.
flavor.en: Forests where Shiinotic live are treacherous to enter at night. People confused by its strange lights can never find their way home again.

flavor.es: Aturde a sus oponentes con un gas venenoso que produce al quemar sus fluidos corporales y luego se abalanza sobre ellos.
flavor.en: It burns its bodily fluids to create a poisonous gas. When its enemies become disoriented from inhaling the gas, it attacks them.

flavor.es: Por algún motivo desconocido, solo hay hembras. Suele formarse su propio harén compuesto por Salandit machos.
flavor.en: For some reason, only females have been found. It creates a reverse harem of male Salandit that it lives with.

flavor.es: Pese a su aspecto encantador, cuando se enoja, sus pataletas son tan feroces que pueden derribar hasta a un luchador profesional.
flavor.en: Despite its adorable appearance, when it gets angry and flails about, its arms and legs could knock a pro wrestler sprawling.

flavor.es: Es un Pokémon muy peligroso por su fuerza descomunal. Normalmente, se desaconseja penetrar en su hábitat.
flavor.en: This immensely dangerous Pokémon possesses overwhelming physical strength. Its habitat is generally off-limits.

flavor.es: Atraídos por el apetitoso aroma que desprende su cuerpo, los Toucannon los engullen con avidez sin ni siquiera masticar.
flavor.en: A delectable aroma pours from its body. They are often swallowed whole by Toucannon lured by that wafting deliciousness.

flavor.es: El cáliz de su cabeza se ha desarrollado y le protege todo el cuerpo. Es tan duro que no le importa que lo picoteen los Pokémon pájaro.
flavor.en: The sepals on its head developed to protect its body. These are quite hard, so even if pecked by bird Pokémon, this Pokémon is totally fine.

flavor.es: Propinar patadas implacables es su especialidad. Patea a sus oponentes derrotados y proclama su victoria con una gran carcajada.
flavor.en: Its long, striking legs aren’t just for show but to be used to kick with skill. In victory, it shows off by kicking the defeated, laughing boisterously.

flavor.es: Prende flores en su tallo, que es muy rico en nutrientes. Las flores se revitalizan y desprenden una agradable fragancia.
flavor.en: It attaches flowers to its highly nutritious vine. This revitalizes the flowers, and they give off an aromatic scent.

flavor.es: Es un Pokémon famoso por su astucia e ingenio. Desprecia a los Entrenadores novatos y prefiere a los más veteranos.
flavor.en: Known for its extreme intelligence, this Pokémon will look down on inexperienced Trainers, so it’s best suited to veteran Trainers.

flavor.es: Suele ir en grupos de unos veinte ejemplares. Sus miembros permanecen siempre unidos y nunca se abandonan unos a otros.
flavor.en: They form groups of roughly 20 individuals. Their mutual bond is remarkable—they will never let down a comrade.

flavor.es: Cuando se asusta, huye despavorido moviendo rápidamente sus múltiples patas. Deja el suelo limpio y pulido allí por donde pasa.
flavor.en: This Pokémon is a coward. As it desperately dashes off, the flailing of its many legs leaves a sparkling clean path in its wake.

flavor.es: Gracias a su destreza y sus enormes y afiladas garras, puede cortar hasta el aire y el agua de un solo tajo.
flavor.en: With a flashing slash of its giant sharp claws, it cleaves seawater—or even air—right in two.

flavor.es: Surgió cuando una persona murió abandonada en plena calle y su resentimiento poseyó un montículo de arena apilado por un niño.
flavor.en: Born from a sand mound playfully built by a child, this Pokémon embodies the grudges of the departed.

flavor.es: Manipulando a la gente ha conseguido transformarse en todo un castillo de arena, lo que ha aumentado su poder maligno.
flavor.en: Possessed people controlled by this Pokémon transformed its sand mound into a castle. As it evolved, its power to curse grew ever stronger.

flavor.es: Vive en las playas y en aguas poco profundas. Expulsa sus entrañas para engañar a sus depredadores y librarse de ellos.
flavor.en: It lives in shallow seas, such as areas near a beach. It can eject its internal organs, which it uses to engulf its prey or battle enemies.

flavor.es: La pesada máscara le impide liberar toda su fuerza, que se cree que es extraordinaria.
flavor.en: The heavy control mask it wears suppresses its intrinsic capabilities. This Pokémon has some hidden special power.

flavor.es: La confianza con su Entrenador ha despertado su potencial. Ahora es capaz de cambiar de tipo a voluntad durante el combate.
flavor.en: Its trust in its partner is what awakens it. This Pokémon is capable of changing its type, a flexibility that is well displayed in battle.

flavor.es: Vive en la capa de ozono hasta que su caparazón se hace demasiado pesado y cae sin remisión a tierra firme.
flavor.en: Originally making its home in the ozone layer, it hurtles to the ground when the shell enclosing its body grows too heavy.

flavor.es: Pasa la vida entera sumido en un profundo sueño. Toda su actividad parece reflejar los sueños que tiene en ese momento.
flavor.en: It is born asleep, and it dies asleep. All its movements are apparently no more than the results of it tossing and turning in its dreams.

flavor.es: Posee un caparazón que estalla al contacto. El orificio que se aprecia en su vientre es su punto débil.
flavor.en: The shell on its back is chemically unstable and explodes violently if struck. The hole in its stomach is its weak point.

flavor.es: Cuando se siente amenazado, eriza las púas de su lomo para pinchar a quien ose atacarlo.
flavor.en: The spiny fur on its back is normally at rest. When this Pokémon becomes agitated, its fur stands on end and stabs into its attackers.

flavor.es: Su verdadero aspecto es un misterio total. Un investigador que intentó mirar dentro del saco recibió, literalmente, un susto de muerte.
flavor.en: Its actual appearance is unknown. A scholar who saw what was under its rag was overwhelmed by terror and died from the shock.

flavor.es: Cuando la protuberancia que tiene en la cabeza emite poderes psíquicos, se escucha como un ruido de dientes rechinando muy molesto.
flavor.en: When it unleashes its psychic power from the protuberance on its head, the grating sound of grinding teeth echoes through the area.

flavor.es: Es de naturaleza mansa, pero si se le provoca y monta en cólera, destruye todo lo que le rodea con su aliento devastador.
flavor.en: It has a compassionate personality, but if it is angered, it completely destroys its surroundings with its intense breath.

flavor.es: Los giros de su enorme ancla son capaces de noquear al mismísimo Wailord de un solo golpe. El alga verde es su verdadero cuerpo.
flavor.en: Swinging its massive anchor, it can KO Wailord in a single blow. What appears to be green seaweed is actually its body.

flavor.es: Comunica sus sentimientos haciendo sonar sus escamas. El ruido metálico producido reverbera en las altas montañas donde habita.
flavor.en: It expresses its feelings by smacking its scales. Metallic sounds echo through the tall mountains where Jangmo-o lives.

flavor.es: Se lanza sobre su presa entonando un grito de guerra. Golpea al enemigo y lo hace trizas con sus escamas.
flavor.en: It leaps at its prey with a courageous shout. Its scaly punches tear its opponents to shreds.

flavor.es: Al avistar a su enemigo, lo intimida con el tintineo que producen las escamas de su cola. Los más débiles se asustan y huyen.
flavor.en: When it spots enemies, it threatens them by jingling the scales on its tail. Weak opponents will crack and flee in panic.

flavor.es: El espíritu guardián de Melemele, curioso e inquisitivo. Invoca nubes de tormenta y acumula el poder de los rayos en su cuerpo.
flavor.en: This guardian deity of Melemele is brimming with curiosity. It summons thunderclouds and stores their lightning inside its body.

flavor.es: El espíritu guardián de Akala, tan inocente como cruel. La fragancia de las flores constituye su fuente de energía.
flavor.en: This guardian deity of Akala is guilelessly cruel. The fragrant aroma of flowers is the source of its energy.

flavor.es: Arranca de cuajo árboles grandes para hacerlos girar. Vuelve exuberante la vegetación y luego absorbe su energía.
flavor.en: It pulls large trees up by the roots and swings them around. It causes vegetation to grow, and then it absorbs energy from the growth.

flavor.es: Desconcierta al enemigo provocando una espesa niebla que se convierte en su perdición. Las corrientes marinas son su fuente de energía.
flavor.en: The dense fog it creates brings the downfall and destruction of its confused enemies. Ocean currents are the source of its energy.

flavor.es: Su cuerpo se compone de una materia gaseosa inestable. Crece poco a poco al acumular las motas de polvo que flotan en el aire.
flavor.en: Its body is gaseous and frail. It slowly grows as it collects dust from the atmosphere.

flavor.es: Permanece inmóvil, como si estuviera muerto, aunque al tocarlo se percibe un ligero calor. Antaño se le llamaba Crisálida de las Estrellas.
flavor.en: Motionless as if dead, its body is faintly warm to the touch. In the distant past, it was called the cocoon of the stars.

flavor.es: Se cree que proviene de otro mundo. El brillo que emite su cuerpo es tal que puede hacer que la noche más profunda parezca pleno día.
flavor.en: It is said to live in another world. The intense light it radiates from the surface of its body can make the darkest of nights light up like midday.

flavor.es: Se dice que es la evolución final hembra de Cosmog. Su tercer ojo aparece cuando se traslada a un mundo distinto.
flavor.en: It is said to be a female evolution of Cosmog. When its third eye activates, away it flies to another world.

flavor.es: Un Ultraente envuelto en misterio. Se dice que las víctimas a las que posee se vuelven agresivas.
flavor.en: One of several mysterious Ultra Beasts. People on the street report observing those infested by it suddenly becoming violent.

flavor.es: Un Ultraente procedente de otro mundo. Se desconoce si exhibe su robusto cuerpo a modo de amenaza o para que lo admiren.
flavor.en: This Ultra Beast appeared from another world. It shows off its body, but whether that display is a boast or a threat remains unclear.

flavor.es: Uno de los temibles Ultraentes. Se dice que ha sido avistado recorriendo la superficie terrestre a velocidades de vértigo.
flavor.en: One of the dangerous Ultra Beasts, it has been spotted running across the land at terrific speeds.

flavor.es: Un Ultraente rodeado de misterio. Se dice que su cuerpo desprende descargas eléctricas de inmensa potencia.
flavor.en: One of the mysterious life-forms known as Ultra Beasts. Astonishing electric shocks emanate from its entire body, according to witnesses.

flavor.es: Este Ultraente surgió de un Ultraumbral. Parece haber sido avistado surcando los cielos a velocidades vertiginosas.
flavor.en: It appeared from the Ultra Wormhole. Witnesses observed it flying across the sky at high speed.

flavor.es: Este Ultraente surgió de un Ultraumbral. Se dice que no es muy agresivo, pero su afilado cuerpo es un arma realmente peligrosa.
flavor.en: This Ultra Beast came from the Ultra Wormhole. It seems not to attack enemies on its own, but its sharp body is a dangerous weapon in itself.

flavor.es: Se dice que este Ultraente ha sido avistado devorando montañas enteras y tragándose prominentes edificios.
flavor.en: It has gobbled mountains and swallowed whole buildings, according to reports. It’s one of the Ultra Beasts.

flavor.es: Se dice que yacía en el interior de la tierra. Se cree que esta criatura, parecida a un Ultraente, vino de otro mundo hace muchísimo tiempo.
flavor.en: Reminiscent of the Ultra Beasts, this life-form, apparently asleep underground, is thought to have come from another world in ancient times.

flavor.es: Pokémon artificial creado hace más de 500 años. Es capaz de entender el lenguaje humano, pero carece de la facultad del habla.
flavor.en: This artificial Pokémon, constructed more than 500 years ago, can understand human speech but cannot itself speak.

flavor.es: Debido a que siempre se ha ocultado en las sombras y no le gusta dejarse ver, su misma existencia es todo un misterio.
flavor.en: Able to conceal itself in shadows, it never appears before humans, so its very existence was the stuff of myth.

flavor.es: En su mundo, este Ultraente se considera tan entrañable como para ser elegido compañero de viaje.
flavor.en: This Ultra Beast is well enough liked to be chosen as a first partner in its own world.

flavor.es: Una de las temibles criaturas conocidas como Ultraentes. En su cuerpo almacena cientos de litros de veneno.
flavor.en: It stores hundreds of liters of poisonous liquid inside its body. It is one of the organisms known as UBs.

flavor.es: Surgió de un Ultraumbral. Parece estar compuesto de varias criaturas que se han combinado para formar un solo ser.
flavor.en: It appeared from an Ultra Wormhole. Each one appears to be made up of many life-forms stacked one on top of each other.

flavor.es: Parece ser uno de los temibles Ultraentes. Se acerca a la gente contoneándose y hace explotar su propia cabeza súbitamente.
flavor.en: It slithers toward people. Then, without warning, it triggers the explosion of its own head. It’s apparently one kind of Ultra Beast.

flavor.es: Hace jirones al oponente con sus garras electrificadas. Aunque este esquive los golpes, acaba electrocutado por las descargas.
flavor.en: It electrifies its claws and tears its opponents apart with them. Even if they dodge its attack, they’ll be electrocuted by the flying sparks.

flavor.es: Su cuerpo está compuesto de acero líquido. Funde las partículas de hierro y otros metales del subsuelo para luego absorberlas.
flavor.en: It melts particles of iron and other metals found in the subsoil, so it can absorb them into its body of molten steel.

flavor.es: En la antigüedad se le veneraba por su poder de crear hierro. Después de tres milenios, ha regresado misteriosamente.
flavor.en: Revered long ago for its capacity to create iron from nothing, for some reason it has come back to life after 3,000 years.

flavor.es: Al marcar el ritmo con su baqueta especial, produce unas ondas sonoras capaces de devolver la vitalidad a la flora.
flavor.en: When it uses its special stick to strike up a beat, the sound waves produced carry revitalizing energy to the plants and flowers in the area.

flavor.es: Los Thwackey que marcan el ritmo más contundente con sus dos baquetas son los más respetados por sus congéneres.
flavor.en: The faster a Thwackey can beat out a rhythm with its two sticks, the more respect it wins from its peers.

flavor.es: Controla los poderes y las raíces de su singular tocón en combate golpeándolo como si fuera un tambor.
flavor.en: By drumming, it taps into the power of its special tree stump. The roots of the stump follow its direction in battle.

flavor.es: Se pone a correr para elevar su temperatura corporal y propagar la energía ígnea por todo el cuerpo. Desata así su verdadera fuerza.
flavor.en: A warm-up of running around gets fire energy coursing through this Pokémon’s body. Once that happens, it’s ready to fight at full power.

flavor.es: Su suave pelaje lo protege del frío y le permite incrementar todavía más la temperatura de sus movimientos de tipo Fuego.
flavor.en: Its thick and fluffy fur protects it from the cold and enables it to use hotter fire moves.

flavor.es: Convierte piedras en balones de fuego dándoles toques y, luego, chuta con fuerza hacia el rival para chamuscarlo.
flavor.en: It juggles a pebble with its feet, turning it into a burning soccer ball. Its shots strike opponents hard and leave them scorched.

flavor.es: Cuando se espanta, libera unas lágrimas con un factor lacrimógeno equivalente a 100 cebollas para hacer llorar también al rival.
flavor.en: When scared, this Pokémon cries. Its tears pack the chemical punch of 100 onions, and attackers won’t be able to resist weeping.

flavor.es: Crea bolas de agua con el líquido que segrega por las palmas de las manos y las usa en combate de forma estratégica.
flavor.en: A clever combatant, this Pokémon battles using water balloons created with moisture secreted from its palms.

flavor.es: Esconde algunos trucos bajo la manga: puede disparar agua por los dedos o planear con las membranas de su espalda.
flavor.en: It has many hidden capabilities, such as fingertips that can shoot water and a membrane on its back that it can use to glide through the air.

flavor.es: Este Pokémon se encuentra por todo Galar. No se queda tranquilo hasta que tiene ambos carrillos atiborrados de bayas.
flavor.en: Found throughout the Galar region, this Pokémon becomes uneasy if its cheeks are ever completely empty of berries.

flavor.es: Se obceca tanto en acumular bayas en la cola que no se da ni cuenta de cuando tiene demasiadas y se le acaban cayendo.
flavor.en: It stashes berries in its tail—so many berries that they fall out constantly. But this Pokémon is a bit slow-witted, so it doesn’t notice the loss.

flavor.es: De naturaleza valiente, planta cara a cualquier rival, por muy fuerte que sea. Los contraataques que recibe le sirven para fortalecerse.
flavor.en: It will bravely challenge any opponent, no matter how powerful. This Pokémon benefits from every battle—even a defeat increases its strength a bit.

flavor.es: Su inteligencia le permite servirse de objetos. Por ejemplo, recoge y lanza piedras con las patas, o utiliza cuerdas para atrapar a su oponente.
flavor.en: Smart enough to use tools in battle, these Pokémon have been seen picking up rocks and flinging them or using ropes to wrap up enemies.

flavor.es: No tiene rival en los cielos de Galar. El acero negro y lustroso de su cuerpo intimida a cualquier adversario.
flavor.en: This Pokémon reigns supreme in the skies of the Galar region. The black luster of its steel body could drive terror into the heart of any foe.

flavor.es: Siempre está recopilando información, por lo que es muy inteligente, aunque su fuerza deja bastante que desear.
flavor.en: A constant collector of information, this Pokémon is very smart. Very strong is what it isn’t.

flavor.es: Apenas se mueve, pero está vivo. Se cree que adquiere poderes psíquicos mientras permanece recluido en su caparazón sin comer ni beber.
flavor.en: It barely moves, but it’s still alive. Hiding in its shell without food or water seems to have awakened its psychic powers.

flavor.es: Este Pokémon es conocido por su inteligencia. El gran tamaño de su cerebro es un indicio de la magnitud de sus poderes psíquicos.
flavor.en: It’s famous for its high level of intelligence, and the large size of its brain is proof that it also possesses immense psychic power.

flavor.es: Se sustenta con el alimento que roba a otros Pokémon. Las almohadillas de sus patas son tan blandas que no hace ningún ruido al caminar.
flavor.en: Aided by the soft pads on its feet, it silently raids the food stores of other Pokémon. It survives off its ill-gotten gains.

flavor.es: Marca a su presa sin ser advertido. Sigue el olor y, cuando el otro Pokémon baja la guardia, aprovecha para robarle.
flavor.en: It secretly marks potential targets with a scent. By following the scent, it stalks its targets and steals from them when they least expect it.

flavor.es: Si planta su única extremidad inferior en la tierra y se expone a abundante luz solar, sus pétalos cobran un color vivo.
flavor.en: It anchors itself in the ground with its single leg, then basks in the sun. After absorbing enough sunlight, its petals spread as it blooms brilliantly.

flavor.es: Las semillas que tiene entre la pelusa son muy nutritivas. Arrastradas por el viento, devuelven la vitalidad a la flora y a otros Pokémon.
flavor.en: The seeds attached to its cotton fluff are full of nutrients. It spreads them on the wind so that plants and other Pokémon can benefit from them.

flavor.es: Su lana rizada es tan acolchada que no se hace daño ni aunque se caiga por un precipicio.
flavor.en: Its curly fleece is such an effective cushion that this Pokémon could fall off a cliff and stand right back up at the bottom, unharmed.

flavor.es: Su lana es muy flexible. Las alfombras tejidas con ella adoptan una textura similar a la de las camas elásticas.
flavor.en: Weave a carpet from its springy wool, and you end up with something closer to a trampoline. You’ll start to bounce the moment you set foot on it.

flavor.es: Muerde todo lo que se le ponga por delante. Al parecer, lo hace para aliviar el dolor que siente cuando le crecen los incisivos.
flavor.en: Apparently the itch of its teething impels it to snap its jaws at anything in front of it.

flavor.es: Un Pokémon de temperamento feroz que atenaza a su presa con sus fuertes mandíbulas, capaces de destrozar una barra de hierro.
flavor.en: With jaws that can shear through steel rods, this highly aggressive Pokémon chomps down on its unfortunate prey.

flavor.es: Al correr, genera electricidad por la base de la cola. Es muy popular entre los pastores de Galar.
flavor.en: This Pokémon is very popular as a herding dog in the Galar region. As it runs, it generates electricity from the base of its tail.

flavor.es: La electricidad que genera y envía a sus patas le ayuda a desplazarse rápidamente. Puede correr sin descanso durante tres días y tres noches.
flavor.en: This Pokémon generates electricity and channels it into its legs to keep them going strong. Boltund can run nonstop for three full days.

flavor.es: Fue descubierto hace aproximadamente 400 años en una mina. Casi la totalidad de su cuerpo presenta una composición igual a la del carbón.
flavor.en: Most of its body has the same composition as coal. Fittingly, this Pokémon was first discovered in coal mines about 400 years ago.

flavor.es: Forma carbón en el interior de su cuerpo. Los antiguos habitantes de Galar lo aprovechaban para sus labores diarias.
flavor.en: It forms coal inside its body. Coal dropped by this Pokémon once helped fuel the lives of people in the Galar region.

flavor.es: Aunque es de carácter sereno, monta en cólera si ve a seres humanos dañando una mina y reduce todo a cenizas con sus llamas a 1500 °C.
flavor.en: It’s usually peaceful, but the vandalism of mines enrages it. Offenders will be incinerated with flames that reach 2,700 degrees Fahrenheit.

flavor.es: Habita durante toda su vida en el interior de una manzana. Finge ser una fruta para protegerse de los Pokémon pájaro, sus enemigos naturales.
flavor.en: It spends its entire life inside an apple. It hides from its natural enemies, bird Pokémon, by pretending it’s just an apple and nothing more.

flavor.es: Ha evolucionado tras ingerir una manzana ácida. Las bolsas de las mejillas albergan un fluido cuya extrema acidez llega a provocar quemaduras.
flavor.en: It ate a sour apple, and that induced its evolution. In its cheeks, it stores an acid capable of causing chemical burns.

flavor.es: Ha evolucionado tras ingerir una manzana dulce. De ahí que el olor que emana para atraer a sus presas, los Pokémon insecto, sea tan agradable.
flavor.en: Eating a sweet apple caused its evolution. A nectarous scent wafts from its body, luring in the bug Pokémon it preys on.

flavor.es: Almacena la arena que ingiere al perforar hoyos en la saca del cuello, cuya capacidad llega a alcanzar incluso los 8 kg.
flavor.en: As it digs, it swallows sand and stores it in its neck pouch. The pouch can hold more than 17 pounds of sand.

flavor.es: Se retuerce para expulsar por los orificios nasales hasta 100 kg de arena. La ausencia de esta mina su ánimo.
flavor.en: When it contracts its body, over 220 pounds of sand sprays from its nose. If it ever runs out of sand, it becomes disheartened.

flavor.es: Su colosal potencia le permite machacar al rival de un solo golpe, aunque su carácter despistado lo lleva a olvidarse de su presencia.
flavor.en: It’s so strong that it can knock out some opponents in a single hit, but it also may forget what it’s battling midfight.

flavor.es: Se siente muy orgulloso de su afilada mandíbula. En cuanto detecta el más mínimo movimiento, va directo al objetivo para cargar contra él.
flavor.en: If it sees any movement around it, this Pokémon charges for it straightaway, leading with its sharply pointed jaw. It’s very proud of that jaw.

flavor.es: Su mandíbula es tan puntiaguda como una lanza y tan dura como el acero. Al parecer, su carne es sorprendentemente deliciosa.
flavor.en: This Pokémon has a jaw that’s as sharp as a spear and as strong as steel. Apparently Barraskewda’s flesh is surprisingly tasty, too.

flavor.es: Secreta toxinas por la piel y las almacena en una bolsa de veneno interna. Tocarlo da calambre.
flavor.en: It stores poison in an internal poison sac and secretes that poison through its skin. If you touch this Pokémon, a tingling sensation follows.

flavor.es: Cuando rasga las protuberancias del pecho para generar energía eléctrica, emite un sonido similar al de una guitarra, que reverbera en el entorno.
flavor.en: When this Pokémon sounds as if it’s strumming a guitar, it’s actually clawing at the protrusions on its chest to generate electricity.

flavor.es: Genera calor consumiendo el gas inflamable que almacena en su cuerpo. Los círculos amarillos del abdomen están particularmente calientes.
flavor.en: It stores flammable gas in its body and uses it to generate heat. The yellow sections on its belly get particularly hot.

flavor.es: Cuando genera calor, su temperatura corporal alcanza aproximadamente los 800 °C. Usa el cuerpo a modo de látigo para lanzarse al ataque.
flavor.en: When it heats up, its body temperature reaches about 1,500 degrees Fahrenheit. It lashes its body like a whip and launches itself at enemies.

flavor.es: Emerge a tierra firme en busca de alimento. Su extrema curiosidad lo induce a golpear con los tentáculos todo lo que entra en su campo visual.
flavor.en: It’s very curious, but its means of investigating things is to try to punch them with its tentacles. The search for food is what brings it onto land.

flavor.es: Todo su cuerpo es una mole de puro músculo. Utiliza los tentáculos para ejecutar técnicas de estrangulamiento con una formidable potencia.
flavor.en: A body made up of nothing but muscle makes the grappling moves this Pokémon performs with its tentacles tremendously powerful.

flavor.es: Según se dice, este Pokémon surgió de un alma solitaria que poseyó una taza abandonada llena de un té ya frío.
flavor.en: This Pokémon is said to have been born when a lonely spirit possessed a cold, leftover cup of tea.

flavor.es: Se hospeda en teteras dignas de un anticuario. Las originales son escasísimas, pero existe un gran número de burdas falsificaciones.
flavor.en: This species lives in antique teapots. Most pots are forgeries, but on rare occasions, an authentic work is found.

flavor.es: Percibe los sentimientos de los seres vivos con la protuberancia de la cabeza. Solo abre su corazón a quienes muestren un carácter sosegado.
flavor.en: Via the protrusion on its head, it senses other creatures’ emotions. If you don’t have a calm disposition, it will never warm up to you.

flavor.es: Silencia a cualquiera que muestre una emoción intensa sin importar de quién se trate y recurre para ello a métodos a cuál más violento.
flavor.en: No matter who you are, if you bring strong emotions near this Pokémon, it will silence you violently.

flavor.es: Para mantener alejados a los demás seres vivos, emana a su alrededor ondas psíquicas cuya potencia es capaz de provocar jaquecas.
flavor.en: It emits psychic power strong enough to cause headaches as a deterrent to the approach of others.

flavor.es: Con el fin de revitalizarse, inhala por la nariz la energía negativa que desprenden tanto personas como Pokémon cuando están descontentos.
flavor.en: Through its nose, it sucks in the emanations produced by people and Pokémon when they feel annoyed. It thrives off this negative energy.

flavor.es: Su estrategia consiste en postrarse ante el rival y fingir una disculpa para ensartarlo con el mechón que tiene en la espalda, afilado cual lanza.
flavor.en: When it gets down on all fours as if to beg for forgiveness, it’s trying to lure opponents in so that it can stab them with its spear-like hair.

flavor.es: Cuando enrolla sus cabellos por todo el cuerpo, aumenta su potencia muscular. Posee una fuerza capaz de someter a Machamp.
flavor.en: With the hair wrapped around its body helping to enhance its muscles, this Pokémon can overwhelm even Machamp.

flavor.es: La potencia de su voz es realmente pasmosa. La técnica que usa para intimidar al rival mientras grita recibe el nombre de Obstrucción.
flavor.en: Its voice is staggering in volume. Obstagoon has a tendency to take on a threatening posture and shout—this move is known as Obstruct.

flavor.es: El pelo de la cabeza se le ha endurecido hasta el punto de parecer un yelmo de hierro. Posee un temperamento muy combativo.
flavor.en: What appears to be an iron helmet is actually hardened hair. This Pokémon lives for the thrill of battle.

flavor.es: Su energía espiritual ha aumentado hasta hacerlo desprenderse de su base caliza. Protege el alma del núcleo con su cuerpo espectral.
flavor.en: Its shell is overflowing with its heightened otherworldly energy. The ectoplasm serves as protection for this Pokémon’s core spirit.

flavor.es: Los ejemplares que superan numerosos combates evolucionan y adoptan esta forma. Abandonan el terreno de combate en cuanto el puerro se seca.
flavor.en: Only Farfetch’d that have survived many battles can attain this evolution. When this Pokémon’s leek withers, it will retire from combat.

flavor.es: Es un bailarín consumado de claqué. Agita su bastón de hielo mientras exhibe su destreza con gráciles pasos.
flavor.en: It’s highly skilled at tap-dancing. It waves its cane of ice in time with its graceful movements.

flavor.es: Una poderosa maldición pesa sobre esta antigua imagen grabada, que ha cobrado vida tras adueñarse del alma de Yamask.
flavor.en: A powerful curse was woven into an ancient painting. After absorbing the spirit of a Yamask, the painting began to move.

flavor.es: Su cremoso cuerpo surgió a partir de la unión de partículas odoríferas de dulces aromas presentes en el aire.
flavor.en: This Pokémon was born from sweet-smelling particles in the air. Its body is made of cream.

flavor.es: Obsequia bayas decoradas con nata a aquellos Entrenadores en los que confía.
flavor.en: When it trusts a Trainer, it will treat them to berries it’s decorated with cream.

flavor.es: Este Pokémon consta de cinco subalternos y un líder, cuyas órdenes obedecen sin rechistar.
flavor.en: Five of them are troopers, and one is the brass. The brass’s orders are absolute.

flavor.es: Libera electricidad por la punta de las púas. Con sus afilados dientes raspa las algas pegadas a las rocas para ingerirlas.
flavor.en: It feeds on seaweed, using its teeth to scrape it off rocks. Electric current flows from the tips of its spines.

flavor.es: Teje un hilo gélido que le permite aferrarse a las ramas y simula ser un carámbano mientras duerme.
flavor.en: It spits out thread imbued with a frigid sort of energy and uses it to tie its body to branches, disguising itself as an icicle while it sleeps.

flavor.es: La temperatura de sus alas es de -180 °C. Sobrevuela el campo esparciendo sus gélidas escamas, como si de nieve se tratase.
flavor.en: Icy scales fall from its wings like snow as it flies over fields and mountains. The temperature of its wings is less than −290 degrees Fahrenheit.

flavor.es: Pasa el tiempo observando inmóvil el recorrido del sol sobre las extensas praderas que habita. Se especializa en técnicas de ágiles patadas.
flavor.en: It stands in grasslands, watching the sun’s descent from zenith to horizon. This Pokémon has a talent for delivering dynamic kicks.

flavor.es: La corriente lo ha transportado hasta aquí desde un lugar sumamente gélido. Utiliza el hielo para mantener la cara refrigerada en todo momento.
flavor.en: It drifted in on the flow of ocean waters from a frigid place. It keeps its head iced constantly to make sure it stays nice and cold.

flavor.es: Percibe las emociones del objetivo con los cuernos de la cabeza. Los machos están atentos a cualquier cosa que necesite su Entrenador.
flavor.en: It uses the horns on its head to sense the emotions of others. Males will act as valets for those they serve, looking after their every need.

flavor.es: Siempre tiene hambre. Se nutre de las semillas que guarda en una suerte de bolsillos para generar electricidad.
flavor.en: As it eats the seeds stored up in its pocket-like pouches, this Pokémon is not just satisfying its constant hunger. It’s also generating electricity.

flavor.es: Su constitución fornida le permite transportar sin inmutarse cargas de 5 toneladas. Utiliza la trompa para excavar la tierra.
flavor.en: It digs up the ground with its trunk. It’s also very strong, being able to carry loads of over five tons without any problem at all.

flavor.es: Su piel verdosa es resistente al agua. Proviene de tierras lejanas y presta ayuda a las personas en la realización de ciertos trabajos.
flavor.en: They came over from another region long ago and worked together with humans. Their green skin is resistant to water.

flavor.es: La robustez de su tren inferior lo hacía invencible en la antigüedad, pero se extinguió tras comerse todas las plantas de las que se nutría.
flavor.en: In ancient times, it was unbeatable thanks to its powerful lower body, but it went extinct anyway after it depleted all its plant-based food sources.

flavor.es: La parte superior del cuerpo está congelada y, al temblar, genera electricidad. Camina con suma dificultad.
flavor.en: The shaking of its freezing upper half is what generates its electricity. It has a hard time walking around.

flavor.es: Su excelente capacidad motriz y la fuerza de su mandíbula lo hacían antaño invencible, pero dar caza a todas sus presas propició su extinción.
flavor.en: Powerful legs and jaws made it the apex predator of its time. Its own overhunting of its prey was what drove it to extinction.

flavor.es: Atrapa a sus presas congelando su entorno, pero la ubicación de la boca encima de la cabeza le genera dificultades para deglutirlas.
flavor.en: Though it’s able to capture prey by freezing its surroundings, it has trouble eating the prey afterward because its mouth is on top of its head.

flavor.es: Su cuerpo, similar a un metal pulido, es tan ligero como robusto. Sin embargo, tiene el defecto de que se oxida con facilidad.
flavor.en: Its body resembles polished metal, and it’s both lightweight and strong. The only drawback is that it rusts easily.

flavor.es: Habitaba los mares en tiempos inmemoriales. Ha revivido en forma de Pokémon de tipo Fantasma para vagar por su antigua morada.
flavor.en: After being reborn as a ghost Pokémon, Dreepy wanders the areas it used to inhabit back when it was alive in prehistoric seas.

flavor.es: Vuela a una velocidad de 200 km/h. Lucha junto a un Dreepy, al que cuida hasta el momento de su evolución.
flavor.en: It’s capable of flying faster than 120 mph. It battles alongside Dreepy and dotes on them until they successfully evolve.

flavor.es: Vive en compañía de Dreepy, a los que hospeda en el interior de sus cuernos. Los dispara a velocidad supersónica en combate.
flavor.en: When it isn’t battling, it keeps Dreepy in the holes on its horns. Once a fight starts, it launches the Dreepy like supersonic missiles.

flavor.es: Este Pokémon está considerado como un héroe de leyenda. Absorbe el metal para transformarlo y emplearlo como armamento.
flavor.en: Known as a legendary hero, this Pokémon absorbs metal particles, transforming them into a weapon it uses to battle.

flavor.es: Este Pokémon se erigió en salvador de Galar, tras unir fuerzas con un rey de los hombres. Absorbe el metal para utilizarlo en combate.
flavor.en: In times past, it worked together with a king of the people to save the Galar region. It absorbs metal that it then uses in battle.

flavor.es: Se alimenta de la energía que brota de la tierra de Galar absorbiéndola por el núcleo del pecho.
flavor.en: The core on its chest absorbs energy emanating from the lands of the Galar region. This energy is what allows Eternatus to stay active.

flavor.es: Perfecciona su técnica mediante una estricta disciplina. Según la corriente marcial que siga, adoptará una forma u otra al evolucionar.
flavor.en: Kubfu trains hard to perfect its moves. The moves it masters will determine which form it takes when it evolves.

flavor.es: Su estilo de lucha se basa en abatir a sus rivales de un solo golpe. Se abalanza sobre ellos con su puño cincelado por el entrenamiento.
flavor.en: This form of Urshifu is a strong believer in the one-hit KO. Its strategy is to leap in close to foes and land a devastating blow with a hardened fist.

flavor.es: Viven en manada en la selva. Debido a su marcada agresividad, son muy temidos por otros Pokémon selváticos.
flavor.en: Within dense forests, this Pokémon lives in a pack with others of its kind. It’s incredibly aggressive, and the other Pokémon of the forest fear it.

flavor.es: Su cuerpo entero es energía eléctrica. Por lo visto, quitarle los anillos que lleva libera su poder oculto.
flavor.en: This Pokémon is a cluster of electrical energy. It’s said that removing the rings on Regieleki’s body will unleash the Pokémon’s latent power.

flavor.es: Cierta teoría afirma que la forma de sus brazos representa la cabeza de un Pokémon dragón ancestral, aunque esto no ha podido verificarse.
flavor.en: An academic theory proposes that Regidrago’s arms were once the head of an ancient dragon Pokémon. The theory remains unproven.

flavor.es: Libera un potente vaho gélido por las pezuñas. Un ser violento que no duda en tomar a la fuerza todo cuanto desea.
flavor.en: Glastrier emits intense cold from its hooves. It’s also a belligerent Pokémon—anything it wants, it takes by force.

flavor.es: Examina su entorno con todos los sentidos, salvo la vista. Se dice que sus coces son capaces de robarle el alma a quien las recibe.
flavor.en: It probes its surroundings with all its senses save one—it doesn’t use its sense of sight. Spectrier’s kicks are said to separate soul from body.

flavor.es: Un Pokémon muy compasivo agraciado con el poder de la curación. Reinó en Galar en tiempos remotos.
flavor.en: Calyrex is a merciful Pokémon, capable of providing healing and blessings. It reigned over the Galar region in times of yore.
The black orbs shine with an uncanny light when the Pokémon is erecting invisible barriers. The fur shed from its beard retains heat well and is a highly useful material for winter clothing.
A violent creature that fells towering trees with its crude axes and shields itself with hard stone. If one should chance upon this Pokémon in the wilds, one's only recourse is to flee.
I believe it was Hisui's swampy terrain that gave Ursaluna its burly physique and newfound capacity to manipulate peat at will.
Clads itself in the souls of comrades that perished before fulfilling their goals of journeying upstream. No other species throughout all Hisui's rivers is Basculegion's equal.
Because of Sneasler's virulent poison and daunting physical prowess, no other species could hope to best it on the frozen highlands. Preferring solitude, this species does not form packs.
Its lancelike spikes and savage temperament have earned it the nickname ”sea fiend.” It slurps up poison to nourish itself.
When it flies to this land from across the sea, the bitter winter comes to an end. According to legend, this Pokémon's love gives rise to the budding of fresh life across Hisui.
Its fluffy fur is similar in composition to plants. This Pokémon frequently washes its face to keep it from drying out.
Floragato deftly wields the vine hidden beneath its long fur, slamming the hard flower bud against its opponents.
This Pokémon uses the reflective fur lining its cape to camouflage the stem of its flower, creating the illusion that the flower is floating.
It lies on warm rocks and uses the heat absorbed by its square-shaped scales to create fire energy.
The combination of Crocalor’s fire energy and overflowing vitality has caused an egg-shaped fireball to appear on the Pokémon’s head.
The fiery bird changes shape when Skeledirge sings. Rumor has it that the bird was born when the fireball on Skeledirge’s head gained a soul.
This Pokémon migrated to Paldea from distant lands long ago. The gel secreted by its feathers repels water and grime.
These Pokémon constantly run through shallow waters to train their legs, then compete with each other to see which of them kicks most gracefully.
A single kick from a Quaquaval can send a truck rolling. This Pokémon uses its powerful legs to perform striking dances from far-off lands.
It searches for food all day. It possesses a keen sense of smell but doesn’t use it for anything other than foraging.
Oinkologne is proud of its fine, glossy skin. It emits a concentrated scent from the tip of its tail.
The ball of threads wrapped around its body is elastic enough to deflect the scythes of Scyther, this Pokémon’s natural enemy.
It clings to branches and ceilings using its threads and moves without a sound. It takes out its prey before the prey even notices it.
It has its third set of legs folded up. When it’s in a tough spot, this Pokémon jumps over 30 feet using the strength of its legs.
When it decides to fight all out, it stands on its previously folded legs to enter Showdown Mode. It neutralizes its enemies in short order.
It has underdeveloped electric sacs on its cheeks. These sacs can produce electricity only if Pawmi rubs them furiously with the pads on its forepaws.
When its group is attacked, Pawmo is the first to leap into battle, defeating enemies with a fighting technique that utilizes electric shocks.
This Pokémon normally is slow to react, but once it enters battle, it will strike down its enemies with lightning-fast movements.
Exhibiting great teamwork, they use their incisors to cut pieces out of any material that might be useful for a nest, then make off with them.
The two little ones just appeared one day. The group might be a family of related Pokémon, but nobody knows for sure.
This Pokémon is smooth and moist to the touch. Yeast in Fidough’s breath induces fermentation in the Pokémon’s vicinity.
The pleasant aroma that emanates from this Pokémon’s body helps wheat grow, so Dachsbun has been treasured by farming villages.
It protects itself from enemies by emitting oil from the fruit on its head. This oil is bitter and astringent enough to make someone flinch.
Dolliv shares its tasty, fresh-scented oil with others. This species has coexisted with humans since times long gone.
This calm Pokémon is very compassionate. It will share its delicious, nutrient-rich oil with weakened Pokémon.
These Pokémon prefer to live in cities. They form flocks based on the color of their feathers, and they fight over territory.
It was born in a layer of rock salt deep under the earth. This species was particularly treasured in the old days, as they would share precious salt.
This Pokémon dry cures its prey by spraying salt over them. The curing process steals away the water in the prey’s body.
Garganacl will rub its fingertips together and sprinkle injured Pokémon with salt. Even severe wounds will promptly heal afterward.
Burnt charcoal came to life and became a Pokémon. Possessing a fiery fighting spirit, Charcadet will battle even tough opponents.
Armarouge evolved through the use of a set of armor that belonged to a distinguished warrior. This Pokémon is incredibly loyal.
The fiery blades on its arms burn fiercely with the lingering resentment of a sword wielder who fell before accomplishing their goal.
Tadbulb shakes its tail to generate electricity. If it senses danger, it will make its head blink on and off to alert its allies.
When this Pokémon expands and contracts its wobbly body, the belly-button dynamo in its stomach produces a huge amount of electricity.
When its wings catch the wind, the bones within produce electricity. This Pokémon dives into the ocean, catching prey by electrocuting them.
Kilowattrel inflates its throat sac to amplify its electricity. By riding the wind, this Pokémon can fly over 430 miles in a day.
It always scowls in an attempt to make opponents take it seriously, but even crying children will burst into laughter when they see Maschiff’s face.
This Pokémon can store energy in its large dewlap. Mabosstiff unleashes this energy all at once to blow away enemies.
Though usually a mellow Pokémon, it will sink its sharp, poison-soaked front teeth into any that anger it, causing paralysis in the object of its ire.
The color of the poisonous saliva depends on what the Pokémon eats. Grafaiai covers its fingers in its saliva and draws patterns on trees in forests.
A soul unable to move on to the afterlife was blown around by the wind until it got tangled up with dried grass and became a Pokémon.
It will open the branches of its head to envelop its prey. Once it absorbs all the life energy it needs, it expels the prey and discards it.
Toedscool lives in muggy forests. The flaps that fall from its body are chewy and very delicious.
These Pokémon gather into groups and form colonies deep within forests. They absolutely hate it when strangers approach.
Klawf hangs upside-down from cliffs, waiting for prey. But Klawf can’t remain in this position for long because its blood rushes to its head.
The more sunlight this Pokémon bathes in, the more spicy chemicals are produced by its body, and thus the spicier its moves become.
The red head converts spicy chemicals into fire energy and blasts the surrounding area with a super spicy stream of flame.
This Pokémon creates a mud ball by mixing sand and dirt with psychic energy. It treasures its mud ball more than its own life.
The body that supports the ball barely moves. Therefore, it is thought that the true body of this Pokémon is actually inside the ball.
Flittle’s toes levitate about half an inch above the ground because of the psychic power emitted from the frills on the Pokémon’s belly.
It immobilizes opponents by bathing them in psychic power from its large eyes. Despite its appearance, it has a vicious temperament.
It swings its handmade hammer around to protect itself, but the hammer is often stolen by Pokémon that eat metal.
This Pokémon will attack groups of Pawniard and Bisharp, gathering metal from them in order to create a large and sturdy hammer.
This intelligent Pokémon has a very daring disposition. It knocks rocks into the sky with its hammer, aiming for flying Corviknight.
This Pokémon can pick up the scent of a Veluza just over 65 feet away and will hide itself in the sand.
It has a vicious temperament, contrary to what its appearance may suggest. It wraps its long bodies around prey, then drags the prey into its den.
It gathers things up in an apron made from shed feathers added to the Pokémon’s chest feathers, then drops those things from high places for fun.
It likes playing with others of its kind using the water ring on its tail. It uses ultrasonic waves to sense the emotions of other living creatures.
This Pokémon changes its appearance if it hears its allies calling for help. Palafin will never show anybody its moment of transformation.
It is said that this Pokémon was born when an unknown poison Pokémon entered and inspirited an engine left at a scrap-processing factory.
It creates a gas out of poison and minerals from rocks. It then detonates the gas in its cylinders—now numbering eight—to generate energy.
Apparently Cyclizar has been allowing people to ride on its back since ancient times. Depictions of this have been found in 10,000-year-old murals.
When attacked, this Pokémon will wield the tendrils on its body like fists and pelt the opponent with a storm of punches.
It absorbs nutrients from cave walls. The petals it wears are made of crystallized poison.
When this Pokémon detects danger, it will open up its crystalline petals and fire beams from its conical body.
It is said that a dog Pokémon that died in the wild without ever interacting with a human was reborn as this Pokémon.
Houndstone spends most of its time sleeping in graveyards. Among all the dog Pokémon, this one is most loyal to its master.
This Pokémon apparently ties the base of its neck into a knot so that energy stored in its belly does not escape from its beak.
This species left the ocean and began living on land a very long time ago. It seems to be closely related to Wailmer.
This Pokémon wanders around snowy, icy areas. It protects its body with powerful muscles and a thick layer of fat under its skin.
When Veluza discards unnecessary flesh, its mind becomes honed and its psychic power increases. The spare flesh has a mild but delicious flavor.
This Pokémon is a glutton, but it’s bad at getting food. It teams up with a Tatsugiri to catch prey.
This is a small dragon Pokémon. It lives inside the mouth of Dondozo to protect itself from enemies on the outside.
When its anger rose beyond a critical point, this Pokémon gained power that is unfettered by the limits of its physical body.
When attacked, this Pokémon will retaliate by sticking thick spines out from its body. It’s a risky move that puts everything on the line.
Now that the brain waves from the head and tail are synced up, the psychic power of this Pokémon is 10 times stronger than Girafarig’s.
This Pokémon uses its hard tail to make its nest by boring holes into bedrock deep underground. The nest can reach lengths of over six miles.
Only a Bisharp that stands above all others in its vast army can evolve into Kingambit.
Sightings of this Pokémon have occurred in recent years. The name Great Tusk was taken from a creature listed in a certain book.
There has been only one reported sighting of this Pokémon. It resembles a mysterious creature depicted in an old expedition journal.
It is possible that the creature listed as Brute Bonnet in a certain book could actually be this Pokémon.
This Pokémon has characteristics similar to those of Flutter Mane, a creature mentioned in a certain book.
This mysterious Pokémon has some similarities to a creature that an old book introduced as Slither Wing.
No records exist of this Pokémon being caught. Data is lacking, but the Pokémon’s traits match up with a creature shown in an expedition journal.
This Pokémon closely resembles a scientific weapon that a paranormal magazine claimed was sent to this planet by aliens.
Its shape is similar to a robot featured in a paranormal magazine article. The robot was said to have been created by an ancient civilization.
It is very similar to a cyborg covered exclusively by a paranormal magazine. The cyborg was said to be the modified form of a certain athlete.
It resembles a certain Pokémon introduced in a paranormal magazine, described as the offspring of a Hydreigon that fell in love with a robot.
This Pokémon resembles an unknown object described in a paranormal magazine as a UFO sent to observe humanity.
It has some similarities to a Pokémon introduced in a dubious magazine as a Tyranitar from one billion years into the future.
Frigibax absorbs heat through its dorsal fin and converts the heat into ice energy. The higher the temperature, the more energy Frigibax stores.
Arctibax freezes the air around it, protecting its face with an ice mask and turning its dorsal fin into a blade of ice.
This Pokémon blasts cryogenic air out from its mouth. This air can instantly freeze even liquid-hot lava.
This Pokémon was born inside a treasure chest about 1,500 years ago. It sucks the life-force out of scoundrels who try to steal the treasure.
Its body seems to be made up of 1,000 coins. This Pokémon gets along well with others and is quick to make friends with anybody.
The grudge of a person punished for writing the king’s evil deeds upon wooden tablets has clad itself in dead leaves to become a Pokémon.
This Pokémon can control 100 tons of fallen snow. It plays around innocently by leaping in and out of avalanches it has caused.
The fear poured into an ancient ritual vessel has clad itself in rocks and dirt to become a Pokémon.
It controls flames burning at over 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit. It casually swims through the sea of lava it creates by melting rock and sand.
It is possible that this is the creature listed as Roaring Moon in an expedition journal that still holds many mysteries.
It has some similarities to a mad scientist’s invention covered in a paranormal magazine.
This seems to be the Winged King mentioned in an old expedition journal. It was said to have split the land with its bare fists.
Much remains unknown about this creature. It resembles Cyclizar, but it is far more ruthless and powerful.
This ferocious creature is shrouded in mystery. It's named after an aquatic monster mentioned in an old expedition journal.
Many of its physical characteristics match those of a Virizion from the future that was covered in a paranormal magazine.
Dipplin is two creatures in one Pokémon. Its evolution was triggered by a special apple grown only in one place.
Supposedly, the regrets of a tea ceremony master who died before perfecting his craft lingered in some matcha and became a Pokémon.
It pretends to be tea, trying to fool people into drinking it so it can drain their life-force. Its ruse is generally unsuccessful.
After all its muscles were stimulated by the toxic chain around its neck, Okidogi transformed and gained a powerful physique.
The chain is made from toxins that enhance capabilities. It stimulated Munkidori's brain and caused the Pokémon's psychic powers to bloom.
Fezandipiti owes its beautiful looks and lovely voice to the toxic stimulants emanating from the chain wrapped around its body.
This Pokémon's type changes based on which mask it's wearing. It confounds its enemies with nimble movements and kicks.
It gathers static electricity from its surroundings. The beams it launches when down on all fours are tremendously powerful.
Seven syrpents live inside an apple made of syrup. The syrpent in the center is the commander.
There are scant few reports of this creature being sighted. One short video shows it rampaging and spouting pillars of flame.
It's said to incinerate everything around it with lightning launched from its fur. Very little is known about this creature.
It resembles a Pokémon described in a dubious magazine as a Terrakion that had been modified by an evil organization.
It resembles a mysterious object introduced in a paranormal magazine as a cutting-edge weapon shaped like a Cobalion.
Terapagos protects itself using its power to transform energy into hard crystals. This Pokémon is the source of the Terastal phenomenon.
It feeds others toxic mochi that draw out desires and capabilities. Those who eat the mochi fall under Pecharunt’s control, chained to its will.
